description: I have all of the resources , capacity and tools to sustain my life #selflove #selfpeace #selfleadership
transcript: I have unlimited capacity for the life that I've built. I don't have to make choices based on necessity. I make choices based on sustainability and the ecosystem that I've created. Every opportunity, commitment, relationship contributes to the ecosystem. I move in flow. As soon as something begins disrupting my flow, I know that that's not for me because I have created a surface that is steady.
